overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice listed the ZBA candidate interviews by name, and a public body may act on any topic listed even without saying it will vote. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the August 2 notice for ZBA candidate interviews should have said the Board would vote to appoint a member, since it voted after the interviews.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require a public body to anticipate the course of deliberation or the outcome of any discussion, only that it identify the discussion topic with sufficient detail to reasonably advise the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.
